title: Ramp onboarding: documented capabilities
method: Existing article cohort, not a ranked or exhaustive market sample. Official public documentation only; no authenticated APIs or production transactions tested.

rows.observation: Widget API documentation covers buy/sell quotes and transaction lookups.
rows.scope: Widget API overview; not a review of every MoonPay product.
rows.unknown: Not verified: eligibility for a specific partner, corridor or payment method.

rows.observation: Not verified: the complete KYC collection and reliance arrangement for the selected widget configuration.
rows.scope: Reviewed Widget API overview; insufficient evidence for a complete KYC responsibility map.
rows.unknown: Request the collection, decision, retention and escalation responsibilities in writing.

rows.observation: The overview lists country, currency and payment-method discovery endpoints.
rows.scope: Endpoint discovery; not a live supported-country audit.
rows.unknown: Not verified: the exact asset/network/method combination for the intended customer.

rows.observation: Widget webhooks document signed delivery, possible duplicates and out-of-order events.
rows.unknown: Not verified: contracted support response and event retention.

rows.observation: The buy-transaction response documents wallet address and currency network metadata.
rows.scope: Response fields, not a tested destination-address validation control.
rows.unknown: Not verified: wallet ownership checks and wrong-network recovery.

rows.observation: The buy response documents status, amounts, fees and a crypto transaction identifier.
rows.scope: API schema example; not an accounting export or completed transaction test.
rows.unknown: Not verified: statement exports, settlement cut-offs and dispute adjustments.

rows.observation: Whitelabel API limitations distinguish bank-transfer flows from semi-widget card/Apple Pay flows.
rows.scope: The API page lists OffRamp as unsupported in its limitations table.
rows.unknown: Not verified: which features are enabled for a particular partner.

rows.observation: The API page distinguishes Lite KYC from a hosted Standard KYC document/liveness step.
rows.scope: Whitelabel journey; not a universal native onboarding claim.
rows.unknown: Not verified: reliance acceptance, data retention and escalation for the buyer.

rows.observation: Public lookups and quotes support configuration discovery.
rows.scope: API documentation, not a live corridor coverage test.
rows.unknown: Not verified: availability for the customer's exact geography and method.

rows.observation: Documentation provides order and KYC webhooks; production registration follows KYB approval.
rows.unknown: Not verified: recovery guarantees, event retention and contracted support.

rows.observation: Create Order documents a destination wallet and additional custodial-wallet information.
rows.scope: Whitelabel Create Order flow; not an ownership-check test.
rows.unknown: Not verified: incorrect network/address handling and recovery.

rows.observation: The API journey includes order-ID polling for final status.
rows.scope: Status polling, not evidence of a complete accounting feed.
rows.unknown: Not verified: settlement exports and refund/fee-adjustment reconciliation.

rows.observation: Native integration uses API/SDK components; access requires an agreement.
rows.scope: Documentation labelled Beta (v0); Native is not self-serve access.
rows.unknown: Not verified: partner access, version commitments and enabled payment methods.

rows.observation: Identity/KYC documentation separates identity verification from transaction eligibility.
rows.unknown: Not verified: the buyer's approved KYC model and ongoing responsibilities.

rows.observation: Configuration endpoints list methods, fiat, countries and cryptocurrencies.
rows.scope: Native configuration endpoints; not a production coverage test.
rows.unknown: Not verified: exact customer, direction, amount and asset/network availability.

rows.observation: Native webhooks describe ramp-status and identity-KYC notifications.
rows.scope: Signed webhook documentation, not a tested delivery guarantee.
rows.unknown: Not verified: contracted replay, retention and escalation arrangements.

rows.observation: Configuration documentation supplies cryptocurrency choices for transaction setup.
rows.scope: Configuration scope only; destination-wallet controls were not established.
rows.unknown: Not verified: wallet ownership, network enforcement and wrong-address recovery.

rows.observation: Ramp webhooks include amounts and fees; transaction hash is conditional on FULFILLED.
rows.scope: Webhook payload scope; not proof of bank settlement or ledger completeness.
rows.unknown: Not verified: settlement statements, corrections and refund matching.
